title: Level comparisons after one further pro-etale localization
statement: Let X,Y be schemes, g:Y→X, d an adic coefficient datum, M an adic tower on X, U in Y.ProEt, V in U.left.ProEt, W in Y.ProEt, and f:W→ProEt.mk(V.hom≫U.hom). For a family D_n of etale lisse-tower complexes on U.left and level comparisons e_n from their realization along U.hom≫g to the corresponding levels of M, there is a family of isomorphisms from the localized fixed realization along f.left to the levels of M pulled back along W.hom≫g [def-weil-pbc-lisse-tower-etale-descent-data, lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback, def-weil-pbc-derived-local-isomorphism-sheaf].

proof.text: Identify fixed realization after inverse image with module inverse image after fixed realization using the associated-module-sheafification and inverse-image adjunctions.
Localize the canonical comparison, paste inverse-image compositors along f.left, V.hom, U.hom and g, and apply it to each supplied e_n.

theorem lisseTower_localized_actual_levels
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y ⟶ X)
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) (M : AdicTower X d)
    (U : Y.ProEt) (V : U.left.ProEt) (W : Y.ProEt)
    (f : W ⟶ ProEt.mk (V.hom ≫ U.hom))
    (D : ∀ n : ℕ, DerivedCategory
      (Sheaf U.left.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n))))
    (e : ∀ n : ℕ, (lisseTowerEtaleRealization (U.hom ≫ g) d n).obj (D n) ≅
      (adicTowerPullback (U.hom ≫ g) ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj (M.level n)) :
    let L (j : ℕ) := (ProEtale.upperStar
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (lisseTowerEtaleRing d j)) f.left).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        lisseTowerFixedRealization (W.hom ≫ g) d j
    Nonempty (∀ (n : ℕ),
    (L n).obj
      ((localProEtaleComparison V.hom (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n)).obj (D n)) ≅
      (adicTowerPullback (W.hom ≫ g) ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj (M.level n))
